{{Quote|Calm down? My brother's murder went unsolved for twenty years, and you expect me to sit across from his murderer and stay calm?|The Alde delegate|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the noble [[House Alde]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] around [[3663 BBY]]. During the [[Alderaan Peace Summit]] twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, [[Sidonie Garen]] falsely accused one of the delegates of the murder, enraging the [[Unidentified Alde delegate|Alde delegate]], the victim's sister.<ref name="TOR" />
